'''Steven Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Tempe tournament (11 June)]] on 11 June 2000 with Yavin 4 Trooper Assault, according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d884">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-out-of-hibernationd884/ out-of-hibernation], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 12 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-out-of-hibernationd884/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
